risks.risk: Missing or damaged internal parts (heating element, pump, hoses) not visible from outside
risks.proof: Photos of the rear panel removed and internal components
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional, parts condition unknown

risks.risk: Water damage or corrosion inside drum/tub not visible in this angle
risks.proof: Close-up photo of drum interior and underside of machine
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst case assuming possible corrosion

risks.risk: Lit display contradicts 'doesn't work' claim — could indicate a simpler fix (e.g., door lock or drain issue) raising resale value, or could be a false/stock photo

risks.if_unproven: priced as fully non-working per seller's stated claim

Photo of the rear panel and visible internals (motor, belt, drum mount)
Close-up of the model/serial sticker (usually on rear or inside door rim)
Photo of the drum interior and tub for rust/corrosion

response.reason: Identity is clear from the LG badge and panel text in photo 0, and the seller's 'doesn't work, scrap' claim cannot be disproven remotely, so the unit is priced at worst case as a non-functional washer/dryer pending any proof of partial function.
